sessions.name: defaults-rolling
sessions.note: D2's defaults on autodj-mid: no tempo or key; the listener's tracks join the ring as they start (D1), quick skips leave it

sessions.name: both-on-floors
sessions.note: both on at every floor step on autodj-mid, Follow the vibe

sessions.name: default-lists-75
sessions.note: autodj-mid-default (k 169) at 75 %: large unions, dry picks

sessions.name: dry-outliers
sessions.note: the synthetic table's outliers (every level below 121) as seeds: the gate passes nothing, the 50 best by the sum of levels

sessions.name: locked-default-lists
sessions.note: Stay on seed on autodj-mid-default at 70 %: the pin's one slot, repeats once its neighbours are cooled

sessions.name: tempo-only-anchor-changes
sessions.note: BPM continuity alone at 65 %, Anchor changed now and then (the pin dropped and retaken)

sessions.name: half-missing
sessions.note: the synthetic table with half the BPMs and keys gone: D3's draws

sessions.name: no-tempo-or-key
sessions.note: no BPM or key on any row: both on, every candidate unknown (mStream's unknown ranks)

sessions.name: damaged-slots
sessions.note: slots whose CRC always fails, fails once, or whose read fails: re-read once, the damaged ring, Io never in it; a reopen clears the ring

sessions.name: broken-slot
sessions.note: a slot with a good CRC over a bad list: broken; random picks over the rows until reopened

sessions.name: tiny-table
sessions.note: autodj-00000029 (6 rows, selFloor 100): the cooldowns and the anchors use up every candidate; random picks; picks by track id

sessions.name: seed-without-a-row
sessions.note: Stay on seed from a track with no row: the first pick is random and becomes the pin

sessions.name: no-index
sessions.note: no index: random library tracks by id, a 50-track cooldown by id, cleared when the tracks are renumbered

sessions.name: surprise
sessions.note: the empty states' Auto DJ button: a random row with a track, then a session seeded by it

sessions.name: long-rolling
sessions.note: 80 picks of Follow the vibe at 70 %: the track cooldown at 50 rows, artists colliding in 16 bits and artist key 0

sessions.name: tempo-unknown
sessions.note: a BPM on one row a cluster only, each seeding a session: candidates mostly without one, the unknown tempo ranks (5, 6, 7 with key matching, 2 without)

sessions.name: tempo-and-key-unknown
sessions.note: a BPM on one row a cluster only and keys on those rows only, each seeding a session: candidates mostly without one, the unknown tempo ranks (5, 6, 7 with key matching, 2 without)

sessions.name: switched-on-mid-queue
sessions.note: Auto DJ switched on with tracks still to play (no seed track): the ring takes them as they start, the pin is the playing track at the first pick

sessions.name: damaged-pin
sessions.note: Stay on seed from a seed whose slot fails its CRC: one random pick, which becomes the pin; later the pin's slot fails after a reopen: the same again

sessions.name: index-arrives
sessions.note: picks by track id while the index is away; it comes back before the last of them starts: that pick joins the ring, so the next pick isn't random

sessions.name: dry-ties
sessions.note: a table whose candidates' sums all tie, below every floor: the 50 dry candidates are the 50 lowest rows
